# What does renting your home to your business for 14 days save you?

> Free Augusta rule calculator. Enter days rented to your own business, a fair daily rent and your tax rates to see the federal, self-employment and state tax saved, net of costs, and how the saving changes if the rate is cut back. Runs in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
